headline: Head-high on paper but S onshore all day — junk until evening.
today: There's size out there, 4-5ft faces at a short 6s from a fair SSE angle, but the S wind is straight onshore at 14-15mph through the morning so it's a wind-chop mess early. Best bet is the evening when it backs to W at 8mph and cleans up a touch around the 5:48p low. Fish or groveler, and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: The clean window this week — dawn N offshore and morning near-glassy with 2.2-3.2ft still hanging around at 6s. Fun size on a fish before the SSE onshore fills in the afternoon.
